test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Some words in the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

Roshni does a __fabulouous__ job at her __company__ and has been __offered__ a __promotion__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option i.e. "**Fabulous**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **fabulouous **is Incorrectly spelt.
 
• The **correct **spelling is **Fabulous **(शानदार) - Extremely good or impressive.
 
 
• **Example**: She looked fabulous in her new dress.
 
 
 
• The other words in the sentence is correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct answer is "Fabulous".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Company **(कंपनी) - A commercial business or firm.

 
 
• **Example**: He works for a large software company.
 
 
 
• **Promotion **(पदोन्नति) - Advancement in rank or position, often in a job.
 
 
• **Example**: She received a promotion to manager last month.
 
 
 
• **Offered **(पेश किया गया) - Presented or proposed for one to accept or reject.
 
 
• **Example**: The job was offered to her after the interview.
 
 

205:T4a0,
The correct answer is 'Option
